Estate Briar Wood & Mixed Materials
Vintage Estate Collection
A diverse collection of 15 vintage estate tobacco smoking pipes featuring classic bowl shapes, finishes, and stems. The grouping includes smooth briar, rustic carved and sandblast textures, a distinctive hand-stitched leather-wrapped bowl, and varied decorative acrylic and vulcanite stems.
Lot Highlights:
15 vintage estate pipes in various traditional shapes (billiard, bent, pot, and freehand profiles)
Assorted finishes including natural smooth grain, deeply rusticated, and stitched leather
Stems feature vulcanite, clear lucite, and amber-swirled acrylic designs
Visible maker stampings include Customcraft and other vintage hallmarks
Condition:

283165205.description:
Natural Agate Geode Half Specimen with Quartz Crystal Center Bookend Pair
Natural agate geode specimen cut in half, revealing crystalline interior with banded gray, white, and purple agate layers surrounding a hollow quartz crystal center. Exterior has rough, unpolished dark gray/brown stone crust, retaining original nodule surface. Two matching halves fit together, commonly used as bookends or display specimens. Banding pattern shows concentric rings of translucent white quartz crystals transitioning to grayish-purple agate, with small hints of green mineral near center. Specimen is in good condition with no visible chips or damage to crystalline surfaces, suitable for mineral collectors or home decor.
